unitModel.space: gap/padding/margin: columns 0 (<3px), 1 (3-13), 2 (14-21), 3 (22-35), 4 (36-47), +1 per 16px over 40; rows 0 (<12px), 1 (12-23), 2 (24-47), +1 per 24px over 24. The runtime's own function (src/term/prim/tokens.ts spaceCells).
unitModel.size: width/height/min/max/basis: columns = px/8 rounded half down (>=1); rows = 1 below 64px, else px/16 rounded half down
unitModel.offset: top/right/bottom/left: px/8 or px/16, rounded half down, may be 0
unitModel.units: ch = 1 column; rem = 16px; em = 13px; % passes through; vw/vh/cq* not expressible
